status: Local definition freeze after synthetic contracts, before new health extraction. Prior lifecycle results known (six invalid missed-row snapshots, ten births). Two already-seen sources; descriptive retrospective audit, not independent confirmation or external preregistration.
execution: Read both original observed lifecycle files, require sealed hashes/bit equality, and audit each independently. Check all three previous full prediction JSON files against original reference bytes before canonicalization, native output/final pickle hashes without loading pickle. Reconcile every original stage/aggregate and immutable cache. No inference, tracking, GT, labels, scores/evaluator, new sources, windows, parameter/default/control/input changes or source reselection. Keep all zeros/failures.

definitions.health: Positive dimensions require finite xyxy, x2>x1 and y2>y1. Input boxes/confidences finite; non-positive width/height separately. Full original high>=.6 /weak<.6 partition, native IoU gate .1 unchanged. Original trace geometry is recomputed from exact cached float32 inputs by prior ledger.
definitions.first: Every born owned hypothesis, all full source frames, not only six known rows. Preserve exact posterior->next before-predict continuity, +1 native clocks, matched ownership, and prune partition. Earliest non-positive observation phase in native chronology: birth, prediction, accepted_high, accepted_weak. One first event per hypothesis plus independent first width/height phase; repeated invalid predictions are row observations, not independent objects.
definitions.accepted_relation: Actual high then weak accepted updates only; birth is a separate seed, never an accepted match. At a first prediction use only strictly earlier accepted history; at a first accepted-posterior violation record current accepted update separately from previous history. Keep stage, prior input/posterior validity, exact gap histogram and seed-only cases. Prediction/accepted transitions and repair/creation counts retain zero branches. No internal Kalman mean/covariance/noise data was recorded, so locate operation/sequence, not numerical root cause or identity correctness.
definitions.gaps: Complete source any/high/weak presence streams; histogram every maximal empty run, mark left/right/both boundary censoring. At every birth and each removal (all three reasons) or source-end survivor, count event-frame availability and nearest strictly earlier/later frames over full source; observed distances separate from censored boundary distances, including censored0. No fitted time window. Global input availability never means same-object observation.
definitions.anchor: Birth context uses its seed box; removal/end context uses last actual accepted detection box, explicitly seed-only if none. For each any/high/weak stream compute positive IoU>0 and original gate>=.1 at event/strict full-source neighbours. Fixed stale anchor geometry, no extrapolation after deletion, no ROI/threshold fit or identity claim. Future neighbours are retrospective context only, never causal support for an intervention.
definitions.terminal: Per removed/censored hypothesis, all frames after last accepted update (or separately labelled seed) through removal/source end inclusive. Count any/high/weak inputs, fixed-anchor positive/gate support and actual alive-prediction positive/gate support separately. Exact terminal-gap and accepted-interupdate/birth-to-first-update histograms; source-end is censored. Row frames may overlap across hypotheses, never pooled as independent source frames or GT misses.
definitions.decision: Describe whether first failures arise from birth, prediction, or accepted posterior, and distinguish absent inputs from geometric non-support. No safe repair, duration, detector threshold or identity claim from these data alone. Decide next separately frozen control/audit only after full ledger; no intervention or promotion in this study.
definitions.public: Only fixed aggregate counts/groups/histograms, all-source source/code/output seals and equality/failure flags. Frame positions, IDs/tokens, boxes, matrices, accepted histories, contextual cases/native states and paths remain ignored local artifacts.

terms: Original KITTI attribution/terms inherited from tracking-past-exposure, local noncommercial research; no media/GT/raw output redistribution or dataset relicensing.
